'''Malain''' is a cavalryman in the [[Saldaean]] army under [[Davram t'Ghaline Bashere]].

== Activities ==
The army arrives in [[Maradon]] as a [[Shadowspawn]] is attacking it. Bashere is about to give Malain orders to attack the fortifications outside the city when a massive horde of [[Trolloc]]s is seen massing on the hillside outside the city.
